Claim 13 (Currently amended): A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data is not limited to signals or transitory media.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code that is not limited to an electronic coupon authorization code.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, wherein the SMS message is not limited to a link to a coupon stored on a manager server.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control short message service (SMS) message to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data, wherein the SMS message is not limited to a generic e-coupon information. 

Claim 25 (Currently amended): A computer readable medium having stored thereon computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the computer readable medium is not limited to signals or transitory media.
